title: Multi-currency support in payment validation
executive_summary: This change adds multi-currency validation to payment processing with CRITICAL risk (score 83). You must reject unsupported currencies before any funds are reserved (CMT-1003), store both original and converted settlement amounts, and read the supported currency list from Currency Service. Three high-risk areas need attention: BUG-201 and BUG-101 show the validator and Currency Service have broken before on exactly this logic, so run TC-1021, TC-1020, TC-1023 and TC-1030, TC-1028, TC-1032; CMT-1001 warns the validator is a shared library that broke Refund Service last time (BUG-332), so confirm the new currency field is optional on the refund path; CMT-1004 notes Currency Service now sits on the hot path and could add latency like BUG-288, so add timeout and fallback handling. Four key requirements lack direct test evidence (REQ-1001, REQ-1002, REQ-1004, REQ-1005), and TC-1035 (concurrent currency test) is failing (EV-3001).

ecr_overview.title: Multi-currency support in payment validation
ecr_overview.description: Modify payment validation logic to support multi-currency transactions and introduce validation for unsupported currencies. The validator must read the merchant supported currency list from the Currency Service, reject unsupported currency codes with UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY before funds are reserved, and store both the original and the converted settlement amount on the transaction record.

change_classification.summary: Payment validation logic is modified to accept multiple currencies, validate against a merchant-supported list from the Currency Service, and reject unsupported codes before fund reservation while storing both original and converted amounts. Changes to core validation and currency handling could break payment processing, settlement calculations, currency conversion, fund reservation timing, and downstream systems depending on transaction record structure.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: This change adds multi-currency validation to payment processing with CRITICAL risk (score 83). You must reject unsupported currencies before any funds are reserved (CMT-1003), store both original and converted settlement amounts, and read the supported currency list from Currency Service. Three high-risk areas need attention: BUG-201 and BUG-101 show the validator and Currency Service have broken before on exactly this logic, so run TC-1021, TC-1020, TC-1023 and TC-1030, TC-1028, TC-1032; CMT-1001 warns the validator is a shared library that broke Refund Service last time (BUG-332), so confirm the new currency field is optional on the refund path; CMT-1004 notes Currency Service now sits on the hot path and could add latency like BUG-288, so add timeout and fallback handling. Four key requirements lack direct test evidence (REQ-1001, REQ-1002, REQ-1004, REQ-1005), and TC-1035 (concurrent currency test) is failing (EV-3001).
